categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the maintainer Validation label and modifies transaction validation order in PreChecks to prevent integer overflow during mempool staging.
categories.rationale: Prevents integer overflows and debug assertion aborts caused by extreme -bytespersigop settings or un-checked transaction sigop costs during staging. As noted in the description, packages or high-sigop transactions can overflow INT32_MAX and abort debug builds on Assume assertions in fee calculations, but the issue is reasonably deferrable as it primarily affects debug builds and non-standard parameter ranges.
